disclaimer: Interactions are in-memory demos only. No auth, payments, remote sync, file upload, push notification, AI or deletion is connected.

flows.title: Onboarding and first run
flows.job: Get users to first meaningful value without forcing irrelevant setup
flows.behavior: Permissions just-in-time; skip and resume; never gate basic exploration without a reason
flows.states: skip; return; no account; denied permission; interrupted setup
flows.verify: Time to first real completed task; all steps keyboard/touch accessible

flows.title: Sign in and account recovery
flows.job: Let users access a real account securely and recover it
flows.behavior: Show accurate errors without revealing user existence; recover session and autofill
flows.states: bad password; lockout; 2FA; resend; offline; expired link
flows.verify: Test auth against real test backend, rate limit, focus on errors

flows.title: Home and task hub
flows.job: Show what matters now, how to act, and current state
flows.behavior: Real task status and freshness; next-action visible; personalization opt-in
flows.states: first use; empty; stale; overloaded; offline
flows.verify: Top task recognizable within 5 seconds; real primary action works

flows.title: App navigation
flows.job: Make moving between important jobs reliable and platform-consistent
variants: adaptive side rail on large screens
flows.behavior: Preserve stack/back history; visible current destination and labeled icons
flows.states: deep link; keyboard; back; many tabs; landscape
flows.verify: Back and focus restore correct on iOS/Android/web targets

flows.title: Search and discovery
flows.job: Find one item precisely with clear matching and recovery
flows.behavior: Debounce expensive queries; query scope and relevance visible
flows.states: typo; zero; partial; unauthorized; slow; offline
flows.verify: Search exact item and recover from misspelling

flows.title: Filters and sorting
flows.job: Narrow or reorganize results without losing user context
flows.behavior: Expose applied vs draft choices, counts, clear and reset, Back
flows.states: zero results; conflicting filters; long facets; keyboard
flows.verify: Results and counts agree; filters persist on detail/back path

flows.title: Lists and activity feeds
flows.job: Scan, group and act on repeated records efficiently
flows.behavior: Stable item identity, timestamps and pagination; action semantics
flows.states: no items; loading; duplicate; 1000+ records; deleted item
flows.verify: Scroll/keyboard preserve place; virtualized lists keep a11y

flows.title: Detail screen
flows.job: Help someone interpret one object and make its next decision
flows.behavior: Correct relationships and source; contextual edit/delete with confirmation
flows.states: missing data; no permission; changed record; deep link
flows.verify: Critical information and action visible; Back state preserved

flows.title: Create and edit
flows.job: Let users produce and save valid work without loss
flows.behavior: Autosave or explicit save honestly represented; undo; dirty-state protection
flows.states: validation; autosave fail; concurrent edit; discard; resume
flows.verify: Kill app mid-edit and verify draft recovery when supported

flows.title: Multi-step forms
flows.job: Collect complex input without overwhelming or losing progress
flows.behavior: Explicit requirements, progress, conditional questions, back editing
flows.states: invalid field; back; resumed draft; API error
flows.verify: Complete with keyboard and screen reader; no data lost

flows.title: Tasks and to-dos
flows.job: Capture, prioritize, finish and undo without distractions
flows.behavior: Meaningful priorities, completion semantics and restore action
flows.states: no tasks; bulk complete; reorder; due date; sync conflict
flows.verify: Complete task, undo, reorder and refresh with correct persistence

flows.title: Calendar and scheduling
flows.job: See time truthfully and resolve collisions
flows.behavior: Time zones, recurrence, daylight saving, accessibility list alternative
flows.states: DST; timezone switch; no events; drag cancel; conflict
flows.verify: Correct date math and keyboard event creation/navigation

flows.title: Analytics and overview
flows.job: Turn up-to-date product data into an informed action
flows.behavior: Units, freshness, missingness, source, drilldowns and actionable context
flows.states: delayed data; null; network error; sparse cohorts
flows.verify: Compare values to data source and chart table accessible labels

flows.title: Notifications and inbox
flows.job: Prioritize real updates, control interruptions and take action
flows.behavior: Real unread state, delivery permission, user preferences and deep links
flows.states: permission off; no alerts; stale link; bulk clear
flows.verify: Deep link lands correct record and respects dismissed state

flows.title: Messaging and conversation
flows.job: Read/write messages without ambiguity or lost text
flows.behavior: Delivery/pending/failure, attachments, identity, timestamps, privacy
flows.states: unsent; offline; retry; large attachment; blocked user
flows.verify: Ordered messages, accessibility announcements and retries

flows.title: Media collection
flows.job: Find, inspect, organize and act on real media
flows.behavior: Real media aspect ratios, licensing/provenance, selection modes
flows.states: permission denied; corrupted media; huge library; empty album
flows.verify: Quick preview and keyboard/image alt navigation

flows.title: Capture and upload
flows.job: Add files or recorded content with clear safety, control and feedback
flows.behavior: File limits, actual progress, cancel/retry, permission timing
flows.states: oversize; unsupported; offline; quota; duplicate
flows.verify: Resume and retry; assistive labels and drag alternative

flows.title: In-app purchase or booking checkout
flows.job: Commit money with exact price and reliable receipt
flows.behavior: Tax, currency, recurring cadence, cancellation, pending state, idempotency
flows.states: declined; 3DS; duplicate click; offline; refund
flows.verify: Sandbox payment flow confirms exact totals; no double charge

flows.title: Premium plan decision
flows.job: Help users make informed subscription choice without coercion
flows.behavior: Current entitlement, trial, cancellation route and restore purchase
flows.states: free; active; restored; cancelled; store unavailable
flows.verify: Entitlement updates accurately and restore path works

flows.title: User profile
flows.job: Present identity, control and privacy without fantasy data
flows.behavior: Consent for public info; edit, privacy and save flow
flows.states: anonymous; missing avatar; profile locked; long name
flows.verify: User can edit and preserve real data across restart

flows.title: Settings and data control
flows.job: Help users change preferences, manage account and understand privacy
flows.behavior: Every toggle persists, consequences understandable; export/delete links real
flows.states: offline change; permission blocked; session expired
flows.verify: Persist/reopen settings and compare values; screen reader names

flows.title: Permission request and denial
flows.job: Ask for OS capabilities at appropriate moments and recover gracefully
flows.behavior: Respect denial, show alternative path, never fake OS dialog
flows.states: deny once; permanent deny; revoked; unsupported hardware
flows.verify: iOS/Android OS path verified where device exists

flows.title: Offline work and sync recovery
flows.job: Keep important data durable and communicate sync truth
flows.behavior: Queued/synced/conflicted clearly different; no data loss
flows.states: offline; reconnect; conflicting edit; retry backoff
flows.verify: Airplane-mode edit then reconcile on reconnection

flows.title: Useful empty states
flows.job: Explain why there is no data and how to start without shame
flows.behavior: Differentiate fresh account from filtered zero/permission-denied
flows.states: fresh; filtered; deleted all; no permissions
flows.verify: Primary action exits empty state; no dead sample card

flows.title: Errors and recovery
flows.job: Turn failure into a practical and honest next step
flows.behavior: What failed, what is saved, next action, no PII in logs
flows.states: timeout; partial failure; backend down; malformed data
flows.verify: Recovery works on second attempt; keyboard focus

flows.title: Undo and destructive actions
flows.job: Make consequential actions reversible or meaningfully confirmed
flows.behavior: Label exact object; undo only if real, time limits obvious
flows.states: delete error; undo expired; double action; focus return
flows.verify: Undo data integrity and focus restoration

flows.title: Accessibility pass
flows.job: Allow users with assistive tech or motor/vision differences to finish tasks
flows.behavior: Actual VoiceOver/TalkBack/keyboard flows; labels, hints and roles
flows.states: large font; magnification; screen reader; switch access
flows.verify: Document actual device/test setup and incomplete checks

flows.title: Multilingual and RTL
flows.job: Ensure language and reading direction work in the whole workflow
flows.behavior: Genuine translations with native review plan; pluralization, fonts, numerals
flows.states: Arabic/Hebrew; long German; CJK; unsupported font
flows.verify: UI mirroring, text overflow and semantics audited

flows.title: Multi-select and bulk actions
flows.job: Let users act on sets with reversible consequences
flows.behavior: Selection stays accurate after filter; undo and scope explicit
flows.states: zero selected; select all pages; disabled rows
flows.verify: Bulk operation affects only intended record IDs

flows.title: Dense data tables
flows.job: Support scanning, sorting and keyboard manipulation of detailed data
flows.behavior: Sorting announces order, sticky semantics, units, export truth
flows.states: thousands rows; horizontal; missing cells; no permission
flows.verify: Sort stable, keyboard and screen-reader row labels

flows.title: AI assistant inside app
flows.job: Make agent help transparent, controllable and falsifiable
flows.behavior: Mark AI uncertainty, citations, consent, tool execution boundaries; never simulate backend
flows.states: model error; unsupported action; stale context; sensitive data
flows.verify: Review every side effect; user cancel and audit trail

flows.title: Account export and deletion
flows.job: Allow accountable exit and clear control of personal data
flows.behavior: Exactly describe data retained and timing; comply with actual backend policy
flows.states: active subscription; offline; request pending; relogin
flows.verify: Deletion request traceable and export valid

journeys.title: Task and to-do app
journeys.job: Capture, prioritize, finish and undo actions without losing work
journeys.thesis: A daily workbench built around the next meaningful action

journeys.title: Calendar and scheduling
journeys.job: See commitments, resolve conflicts and reschedule across time zones
journeys.thesis: An adaptive time canvas with visible local time and conflict

journeys.title: Privacy-first journal
journeys.job: Write without setup, save privately, search and export entries
journeys.thesis: A readable writing space, not a gamified mental-health dashboard

journeys.title: Habits and routines
journeys.job: Plan realistic routines and recover after missing sessions
journeys.thesis: Supportive progress visualization without punitive streaks

journeys.title: Workout tracker
journeys.job: Find exercises, log a session, resume interrupted tracking
journeys.thesis: Session-first hierarchy with large readable controls

journeys.title: Education and language learning
journeys.job: Find level, practice, get accurate feedback and revisit a lesson
journeys.thesis: A learning path revealing actual capability rather than points theatre

journeys.title: Ebook and reading library
journeys.job: Find a title, read, bookmark and resume offline
journeys.thesis: A book-first interface with typography above chrome

journeys.title: Creative editor and design canvas
journeys.job: Import, edit, preview, export and recover failed work
journeys.thesis: Canvas-centered creation with tool panels only when needed

journeys.title: Camera and photo editor
journeys.job: Capture, review, edit and export with controlled permissions
journeys.thesis: Make the camera itself the primary task, not an onboarding slide

journeys.title: Music and video streaming
journeys.job: Discover media, play and resume, handle downloads/expiry
journeys.thesis: Content and playback continuity, with clear offline rights

journeys.title: Social/community network
journeys.job: Find relevant communities, post, manage privacy and harm reporting
journeys.thesis: Community context and informed control before engagement counters

journeys.title: Messaging and collaboration
journeys.job: Find a thread, communicate, see delivery state and retry failures
journeys.thesis: Conversation-first, resilient drafts and transparent delivery

journeys.title: Shopping and marketplace
journeys.job: Search inventory, compare, buy accurately and inspect order
journeys.thesis: A decision-first mobile shop, not a wall of promotions

journeys.title: Travel and booking
journeys.job: Choose dates/inventory, see total cost, book, then amend
journeys.thesis: An accurate itinerary ledger with recoverable choices

journeys.title: Personal finance viewer
journeys.job: See balances, provenance, pending activity and data controls
journeys.thesis: A real evidence-led ledger with no decorative fake gains

journeys.title: Meditation and calm practice
journeys.job: Find a fitting session, complete it, optionally reflect
journeys.thesis: A calm player that never punishes users for time away

journeys.title: AI work assistant
journeys.job: Give a task, review cited evidence, approve actions and recover failure
journeys.thesis: A transparent workbench keeping the human in control

journeys.title: Offline knowledge base
journeys.job: Capture without network, merge and search safely
journeys.thesis: Reliable instant capture with honest synchronization status

journeys.title: Business operations dashboard
journeys.job: Detect anomaly, verify source, act, audit result
journeys.thesis: Dense but legible evidence-first operational UI

journeys.title: Game companion and collectibles
journeys.job: Manage current game state, coordinate tasks and preserve progress
journeys.thesis: Playful art direction nested in familiar and accessible controls
